title: 1290 Super Adventure S (Circuit Spec)
description: Positioned for riders seeking dedicated Adventure Tourer capability, the KTM 1290 Super Adventure S (Circuit Spec) delivers all-weather long-haul versatility with long-travel suspension compliance. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. Focused on closed-course control and sporting precision, its Aggressive Forward Tuck posture pairs with a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines to optimize high-speed aerodynamic stability.
